known_policies.topic: Original branch identities and displayed order
known_policies.implementation: Keep original choice IDs, labels and full faces; option order follows printed root text where no ordered client script is available

known_policies.evidence: Player live-game report: combined mode allows heroes but only heals them; minions take damage then healing
known_policies.implementation: Character target domain; damage component only for minions, then ordinary spell healing

known_policies.topic: Summon before buffs in explicit combined bodies
known_policies.evidence: Community discussion reports favorable summon-then-buff behavior; exact special-card order is retained as local policy
known_policies.implementation: Each combined body has explicit ordered public effects; no generic concatenation of branch text

known_policies.evidence: Community rules description says unplayable choice options are disabled, including summon options at a full board
known_policies.implementation: Use the existing requires_board_space branch declaration

known_policies.topic: Mixed combined bodies with no existing minion target
known_policies.implementation: Optional-minion combined target policy: resolve summons even if no original legal minion target exists; skip only targeted buff; do not select a newly summoned minion retroactively

known_policies.topic: Original target residence and named minions
known_policies.implementation: Capture original board presence for stats and keywords across prior summons; use exact original token identity, not a generic similar body
